name: Valves and actuators
applications: flow, pressure, temperature and level control
principle: A control valve varies the flow passage as directed by a controller signal; an actuator moves the valve and a positioner confirms its position. Air-actuated valves are most common.

process_steps.name: Controller signal sent to the positioner
Actuator moves the valve stem or shaft
